# SEO-186: Detect entity references that resolve to no node in the graph

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

Every identifier used as a reference in the emitted graph resolves either to a node defined in the same graph or to an identifier the site defines on another route it publishes.

## Rationale

A reference with nothing behind it looks structurally correct while carrying no information, and this is the usual result of deleting or renaming a node without updating the templates that pointed at it.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_structured_data"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Collect the defined identifiers and the referenced identifiers across the routes the build produces, and fail the build on a reference with no definition. This is a consistency check over the site's own output and needs no external judgement.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Build the sets of defined and referenced identifiers from the parsed graphs of all sampled routes and report the difference.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `BUILD_OUTPUT`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.
